Summary
The Intelligent Research Assistant follows a layered modular architecture that separates
presentation, application, retrieval, and storage components. This architecture enables se-
cure user authentication, efficient semantic retrieval, and reliable AI-generated responses
with proper citations while maintaining scalability and extensibility. “‘
4.7
Database Design
The Intelligent Research Assistant uses a hybrid storage architecture that combines re-
lational databases, document storage, and vector databases. Each storage technology is
selected according to the nature of the data it manages.
• SQLite stores structured application data.
• MongoDB stores uploaded documents and extracted content.
• FAISS stores vector embeddings for semantic retrieval.
• JSON files store metadata and chunk information.
This hybrid architecture improves scalability while maintaining efficient access to
structured and unstructured data.
